thesis: The page is a rail track of crossties: every section is one tie laid down with its week number stenciled on the end, and scrolling moves the amber today line forward so each tie flips from upcoming to done.

signature.name: crosstie track
signature.summary: horizontal tie bars with stenciled week numbers and Friday report cards, connected by two steel rails and an advancing amber today-line

motion.intro: rails draw down 900ms then h1 line-mask reveal 70ms stagger; skippable
stories: today-line scrubs down track scrubbing ties to DONE
estimator bar fills segment-by-segment at budget station
motion.hover: hairline rule grows from left scaleX 200ms
